gloss: surely not; never would have thought

definitions.gloss: surely not; never would have thought; by no means
definitions.explanation: Expresses strong disbelief or the assumption that something is extremely unlikely. More literary and emphatic than まさか, often followed by a negative expression or an expression of disbelief.

examples.japanese: よもや⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧。
examples.english: I never would have thought it would come to this.

examples.japanese: よもや⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I never thought we would lose.

examples.japanese: よもや⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧だった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}しなかった→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧。
examples.english: Nobody imagined that he could possibly be the culprit.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary adverb expressing strong disbelief or the conviction that something is nearly impossible. More formal and dramatic than ⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧. Often appears in the pattern よもや～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (never would have thought that ~) or よもや～まい (surely ~ won't happen). Gained renewed popularity through the anime Demon Slayer ({鬼滅|きめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|やいば}→刃：19342_yaiba⟧), where the phrase よもやよもやだ was used memorably.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- よもや～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (never would have thought that ~)
- よもや～まい (surely ~ won't)
- よもやよもや (expressing extreme disbelief — emphatic repetition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧: no way, surely not — more colloquial and widely used
- ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧: (nonstandard) — sometimes confused, not a real word
- ⟦{到底|とうてい}→到底：06685_toutei⟧: by no means — used with negatives, focuses on impossibility
